description:
Surface the adapter's streaming capability (already implemented per
ARCH §4.4 streaming response shape, and advertised in
lernie-provider-anthropic's describe.capabilities) through the
harness CLI, and consume it from the UI as a live-rendering text
panel.

=== Scope ===

1. lernie prompt --stream flag (src/bin/lernie.rs): when set, the
   harness invokes the adapter's complete with stream:true, reads
   the JSONL event stream (message_start, content_block_start,
   text_delta, tool_use_delta, content_block_stop, message_stop),
   and emits the normalized §4.4 events on stdout one-per-line.
   Non-stream default unchanged. The on-disk step record still
   lands as before; --stream just adds a live stdout side-channel
   for the frontend.

2. lernie-ui-egui streaming response pane: a panel showing the
   currently-active conversation branch's incremental text. Spawns
   lernie prompt --stream via cli_outbound (which already
   stream-chunks stdout/stderr line-by-line); a pure parser turns
   §4.4 events into (text-so-far) and the egui side renders that
   string. State lives in the streaming events themselves; nothing
   persists across renders — matches §3.5 stateless-frontend.

=== Constraints ===

- The streaming side-channel is purely UI-visible. The on-disk
  shape (steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/{request,response}.json) does not
  change — non-stream callers see identical behavior.
- No new event types beyond what §4.4 already pins.
- 100% line coverage on all new code; existing 100% floor stays.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: v0.5 Phase 7: lernie prompt --stream + UI streaming response pane
